blocks.text:
You have the day at leisure. After the previous day's sightseeing, you can rest and get ready for the Carnival show that night.

The Sambadrome is a long parade arena where samba schools perform between the grandstands. The Parade of Champions takes place on **13 February 2027**. Tickets are included in the tour price. The best seats are usually booked in advance, so the Carnival evening is part of the organised itinerary.

The samba schools perform one after another, with drum sections, dancers, costumes and large moving floats. More than 10,000 participants pass the grandstands over the course of the night. The audience hears recurring themes and choruses, while each school brings its own colours, music and sets.

The parade runs along one long avenue. As one procession ends, the next is already appearing at the head of the route. Each school uses costumes, floats, percussion and choreography to tell a story. As the night goes on, the differences between performances become easier to pick out and the crowd gets more involved.

The parade continues all night. A transfer back to the hotel is provided after the parade.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, visit Corcovado. An open train climbs through Tijuca Forest. The city gradually disappears behind the trees, then views of Rio open up again near the summit.

The statue of Christ the Redeemer stands on Corcovado. From the lookout you can see Guanabara Bay, the beaches, Maracanã Stadium, the Botanical Garden and Sugarloaf Mountain. After Sugarloaf, Corcovado gives you another high vantage point over the city from a different direction.

The ascent is part of the visit. The train passes through humid Tijuca Forest, where the buildings disappear for a while. From the summit, you can see the coastline, beaches, lagoons, granite peaks and densely built neighbourhoods in a single panorama. Corcovado rounds off your time in Rio before the flight to Iguazú.

Around sunset, you can walk out to Arpoador, the rocky headland between Copacabana and Ipanema. In the evening, you can have dinner at Marius seafood restaurant. **Price:** $130 per person.
